description: This file contains unit tests for the Timesheet functionality within the ERPNext project, including creation of test data, validation of billing amounts, and integration with sales invoices and salary slips.

classes.name: TestTimesheet
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase subclass that tests various aspects of the Timesheet module, including billing calculations, salary slip creation, sales invoice creation, and time overlap validation.

methods.name: setUpClass(cls)
methods.description: Sets up salary components for testing that are run once before all tests.

methods.name: setUp(self)
methods.description: Prepares the database before each test by deleting relevant records.

methods.name: test_timesheet_billing_amount(self)
methods.description: Validates billing amount calculations for a billable timesheet.

methods.name: test_timesheet_billing_amount_not_billable(self)
methods.description: Verifies that non-billable timesheets result in zero billing amounts.

methods.name: test_salary_slip_from_timesheet(self)
methods.description: Checks creation and validation of a salary slip derived from a timesheet.

methods.name: test_sales_invoice_from_timesheet(self)
methods.description: Ensures sales invoices generated from timesheets have correct item details and total billing.

methods.name: test_timesheet_billing_based_on_project(self)
methods.description: Validates that timesheet billing is correctly associated with a project.

methods.name: test_timesheet_time_overlap(self)
methods.description: Verifies that overlapping time logs are correctly handled with validation errors or ignored based on settings.

methods.name: make_salary_structure_for_timesheet(employee, company=None)
methods.description: Creates a salary structure suitable for timesheet-based calculations, if it does not already exist.

methods.name: make_timesheet(employee, simulate=False, is_billable = 0, activity_type="_Test Activity Type", project=None, task=None, company=None)
methods.description: Generates a test timesheet with optional simulation of overlapping times, for use in tests.

methods.name: update_activity_type(activity_type)
methods.description: Updates the billing rate of an activity type to a fixed amount for testing purposes.

ctags.name: make_timesheet
ctags.pattern: /^def make_timesheet(employee, simulate=False, is_billable = 0, activity_type="_Test Activity Type/
ctags.signature: (employee, simulate=False, is_billable = 0, activity_type="_Test Activity Type", project=None, task=None, company=None)
